data.one_liner: Detects and removes unused localization keys from .arb files.
data.what_it_does: Scans Dart files in project directories to detect used localization keys, then automatically removes unused keys from .arb files or reports them.
use_when: You want to clean up unused localization keys across multi-language .arb files
You work in a monorepo or standard project and need to scan custom directories for localization usage
avoid_when: You dynamically construct localization keys at runtime that static analysis cannot detect
strengths: Supports multiple languages and global localization variables
Configurable dart scan directories for monorepos
Prevents false deletions by safely excluding core localization files
weaknesses: Relies on static regex analysis which might miss heavily obfuscated dynamic key lookups
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and run via dart run remove_unused_localizations.
